reasons: Position is deep inside the corridor: LTV 0.3825 is below both the act level 0.7 and target 0.5, and a 55.52% collateral price drop is needed to reach the 86% liquidation LTV.

The fired feed_stale screen on live is marginal: ETH/USD age 1202 s vs 1200 s max (2 s over), the answer is positive, and the pool price equals the oracle price (0.0% divergence), so there is no sign of a pricing anomaly.
Market conditions are healthy: utilization 0.5946 is under the 0.95 threshold, borrow APR is 0.57%, and 5.27 loan tokens remain available to borrow.

Migration would not improve safety: backup carries the identical stale ETH/USD feed and demo uses a team-set mock oracle with no feeds at all; the venue-status feed reports no open incident for these markets' oracles or pools.
The Base Denim upgrade is a scheduled event later today (18:00-20:00 UTC) with mainnet expected to remain operational, so it is not a present risk to this position.

items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
